Partners is one of the most popular board games in the Nordic Countries! Now 20 years after the first copy of the board game was released, the app is finally here!

If you and your partner make it before your opponents, you win!

You can play this game online with family and friends, but you do NOT need them in order to be able to play. There have been times when we won and lost a few games in a row because of the dice - just like when playing the board game!
